meta.title: Support
meta.description: Get help with SMS Code — activations, billing, coins and account questions. Read troubleshooting guides or contact our support team by email.

page.label: Support
page.title: How can we help?
page.introBefore: Send us a message below or email
page.introAfter: — pick a topic first: most answers are one tap away, and anything else reaches a person.

items.title: Refunds
items.body: App Store purchases are billed by Apple, so refunds are requested from Apple and decided by Apple. The guide walks you through it in under two minutes.

items.title: SMS didn't arrive
items.body: Delivery depends on the service, the country and the service's own checks. If nothing arrives, the coins come back automatically. See which countries are working best right now.

items.title: Missing coins
items.body: Paid but no coins? It is usually a pending Apple payment or a different SMS Code account. Check these steps before buying again.

items.title: Keeping your balance
items.body: Your coins live with your SMS Code account, not with the App Store receipt. Sign in (Apple, Google or an email code) while you have coins and they follow you to any device.

page.safetyTitle: Choosing a country and staying safe
page.safetyLink: How to choose a country and protect your account

form.name: Your name

sms.title: Before you write: most missing SMS resolve on their own
points: If no SMS arrives within the activation window, the activation closes and its coins return to your balance automatically.
Delivery depends on the service and the country. Some services block virtual numbers in certain countries, so try another country with a better delivery level.
Make sure the service sends the code by SMS, not by voice call or to an app you are already signed into.

code.title: Before you write: why a code gets rejected
points: The service decides whether it accepts a number. A number that was used before, or a country the service restricts, can be refused even after the SMS arrives.
Use the newest code, for the same account and service, without spaces.
Stop repeating paid attempts on the same service and country. Switch country, or write to us for a review.

coins.title: Before you write: where coins usually are
points: A pending Apple payment can take a few minutes. Reopen the app before buying again.
Coins belong to the SMS Code account that bought them. Sign in with the same Apple, Google or email login.
Still missing? Send us your Apple order ID (from the Apple receipt email) and we will trace it.

account.title: Before you write: account answers
points: Sign in with Apple, Google or an email code to keep your balance on any device.
You can delete your account in the app: Settings → Delete account. Deleting does not refund an Apple payment.
Lost a balance after reinstalling? Write to us with your Apple order ID.

form.solvedBody: If anything changes, come back to this page any time.
form.refundNote: We can't issue refunds for App Store purchases. Only Apple can approve them, at reportaproblem.apple.com. Write to us if Apple asked you to contact the developer, or if you need purchase records.
form.accountAttached: Your SMS Code account ID and app version are attached, so you don't need to look them up.

help.stillNeedBody: If this page didn't solve it, send us a request. It reaches a person, and the details above help us answer faster.

tiers.title: Where SMS is arriving right now
tiers.intro: Pick a service to see how reliably an SMS has reached our numbers in each country over the last 30 days. If your country is low, switch to a high one.
tiers.note: Based on recent SMS Code activations and refreshed hourly. Only service and country pairs with enough recent orders are shown. Past delivery doesn't guarantee the next SMS, and the service still decides whether to accept the number.
